   - Python `decimal`: `Decimal.quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=...)`, ROUND_HALF_UP vs ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding).
   - `Decimal(float)` carries binary representation error (e.g. 2.675 becomes 2.67499…), so the inputs to `refund_amount` can cause one-cent errors.
   - Each module has a module-level `ROUNDING_MODE` constant used by its many near-identical rate helpers. `refund_amount` instead delegates to `legacy.money.to_cents`, which has its own hardcoded rounding.

       from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN
       from legacy.money import to_cents

If a fetched URL served binary content (a PDF, for example), a harness note after the report — marked as not part of the agent's report — lists the local file the fetched server's raw bytes were saved to. It stays addressable after it finishes: send follow-up questions about pages it has already read via SendMessage instead of spawning a new one for the same page.
